name: Overdue Books
query:
SELECT 
    loan.name AS "Loan ID",
    book.title AS "Book Title",
    member.full_name AS "Borrower",
    loan.loan_date AS "Loan Date",
    loan.return_date AS "Due Date",
    DATEDIFF(NOW(), loan.return_date) AS "Days Overdue"
FROM 
    `tabLoan` AS loan
JOIN 
    `tabBook` AS book ON loan.book = book.name
JOIN 
    `tabMember` AS member ON loan.member = member.name
WHERE 
    loan.return_date < NOW() AND book.status = "Loaned"
ORDER BY 
    loan.return_date ASC;
